CO-amache-reflection.caption: The barracks at the Granada Relocation Center, also known as Amache.

ID-idaho-state-capitol.caption: The Idaho State Capitol in Boise.

MS-grand-gulf-military-park.alt: Remains of Fort Cobun at Grand Gulf Military State Park near Port Gibson.

MS-fort-massachusetts-ship-island.caption: Brick arches inside Fort Massachusetts on Ship Island.

bayhorse.alt: Mining structures at the Bayhorse townsite in Idaho.
bayhorse.groundReview: National Register listing 76000671 appears in the source and the dossier. Timber-sided mine structures climb the slope within the historic mining town shown in the district photograph.

cataldo-mission.alt: The parish house yard east of the church at Cataldo Mission, August 30, 1975.

cataldo-mission.alt: The front of the Sacred Heart Mission at Cataldo in a 1913 Barnard Studio photograph.

cataldo-mission.alt: The Sacred Heart Mission facade from the approach at Cataldo, August 2021.

ID-wallace-brick-core.rightsReview: Photographer’s own-work declaration and file-page license checked. Same license retained for the resized WebP.

CENTER OF THE UNIVERSE and WALLACE IDAHO encircle the compass. BHM, HL, CDE and SRLM are visible around the outside.

ID-nine-mile-cemetery.alt: The cobblestone memorial to five firefighters at Nine Mile Cemetery outside Wallace, May 2015.
ID-nine-mile-cemetery.groundReview: The photographer’s full description places the firefighters’ grave at Nine Mile Cemetery. The dossier identifies the Wallace 1910 Fire Memorial and its paired stone enclosures. A fieldstone memorial stands inside the low walled grave plot, on the slope with cemetery markers behind it.
ID-nine-mile-cemetery.rightsReview: Photographer’s own-work declaration and file-page license checked. Same license retained for the resized WebP.

ID-pulaski-tunnel-trail.rightsReview: Item-level standardized rights: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/mark/1.0/. Source credit and collection identifier retained.

ID-pulaski-tunnel-trail.alt: The restored entrance to the Pulaski Tunnel near Wallace in 2010.

A heavy timber lintel and vertical posts surround the dark opening in the wooded slope. The restoration is visible without inferring original surviving timbers.
ID-pulaski-tunnel-trail.rightsReview: The item identifies a United States Forest Service photograph and carries the federal Forest Service public-domain notice. Agency source reference stelprdb5441228 is retained in the Commons record.

bunker-hill-kellogg.rightsReview: Item-level standardized rights: http://rightsstatements.org/vocab/NoC-US/1.0/. Source credit and collection identifier retained.
